ThreeWayMatch.title: Match exceptions
ThreeWayMatch.body: Supplier bills whose three-way match does not add up: ordered, received and billed disagree, or nothing was received at all. The list shows the open exceptions with supplier, amount at risk and age; open a row for the line-by-line comparison. You confirm the match when the variance is explainable, or override it with a reason; both stay documented on the record.
